zone1_focus_productivity.name: 🧠 Focus & Productivity Zone
zone1_focus_productivity.description: Master your focus, boost productivity, and achieve flow state

commands.!focus: Start a focus session with Pomodoro timer
commands.!goals: Set and track daily focus goals

help_content.getting_started: Use !focus to start a 25-minute focus session. The bot will guide you through setup and provide reminders.
best_practices: Start with shorter sessions (15-20 min) if you're new to focus work
Use !break between sessions to prevent burnout
Set clear intentions before each focus session
Track your peak focus times with !energy

troubleshooting.cant_focus: Try !distractions to block interruptions, or !energy to check if you need a break
troubleshooting.too_long: Customize session length with !focus 15 for shorter periods

zone2_community.name: 👥 Community Engagement Zone
zone2_community.description: Connect, collaborate, and build meaningful relationships

commands.!connect: Find community members with similar interests
commands.!mentor: Find mentors or become a mentor

features: 🤝 Smart member matching based on interests

help_content.getting_started: Use !introduce to create your profile and !connect to find like-minded community members.
best_practices: Be genuine and authentic in your interactions
Offer help before asking for it
Respect neurodiversity and different communication styles
Use !support when you need help - the community is here for you
community_guidelines: No judgment zone - we're all learning together
Celebrate each other's victories, big and small

zone3_achievement.name: 🏆 Achievement & Progress Zone
zone3_achievement.description: Track progress, celebrate wins, and unlock achievements

commands.!badges: View earned badges and next targets
commands.!level: Check your current level and XP

help_content.getting_started: Use !progress to see your current goals and !achievements to view what you can unlock.
tips: Set small, achievable goals to build momentum
Celebrate small wins - they add up!

zone4_crisis_support.name: 🛡️ Crisis Support Zone
zone4_crisis_support.description: Immediate help, resources, and professional support

commands.!hotlines: Access crisis hotlines and emergency contacts

help_content.immediate_help: If you're in crisis, use !crisis for immediate resources or !hotlines for professional support.
when_to_seek_help: Feeling overwhelmed or unable to cope

emergency_resources: 🇺🇸 Crisis Text Line: Text HOME to 741741

zone5_creative.name: 🎨 Creative Collaboration Zone
zone5_creative.description: Unleash creativity through collaborative projects and artistic expression

help_content.getting_started: Use !create to start a project or !inspire for creative prompts. Share your work with !showcase.
collaboration_tips: Be open to different creative perspectives

zone6_learning.name: 📚 Learning & Growth Zone
zone6_learning.description: Expand knowledge, develop skills, and pursue continuous learning

help_content.getting_started: Use !learn to explore available paths or !skills to assess your current abilities.
learning_strategies: 🕐 Use spaced repetition for long-term retention
🎯 Break large topics into smaller chunks
adhd_friendly_tips: Use timers for focused study sessions
Create visual mind maps and diagrams
Take frequent breaks to maintain focus
Use multiple learning modalities (visual, auditory, kinesthetic)

zone7_wellness.name: 🌿 Wellness & Self-Care Zone
zone7_wellness.description: Prioritize mental health, physical wellness, and emotional balance

commands.!wellness: Check wellness status and get recommendations
commands.!nutrition: Get nutrition tips and meal planning

features: 📱 Digital wellness and screen time management

help_content.getting_started: Use !wellness for a comprehensive health check or !mood to start tracking emotional patterns.
self_care_strategies: Listen to your body and energy levels
Create consistent routines that work for you

zone8_goals.name: 🎯 Goal Setting & Planning Zone
zone8_goals.description: Set meaningful goals, create actionable plans, and track progress

help_content.getting_started: Use !goals to set your first goal or !plan to create an action plan for existing goals.
goal_setting_tips: Make goals Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound
Start with smaller goals to build confidence
Break large goals into smaller, actionable steps
Regular review and adjustment is key to success
planning_strategies: Use backward planning from your desired outcome
Identify potential obstacles and plan solutions
Set both process goals and outcome goals
Build in flexibility for unexpected changes

zone9_social.name: 💬 Social Connection Zone
zone9_social.description: Build meaningful relationships and strengthen social bonds

commands.!connect: Find and connect with like-minded people

help_content.getting_started: Use !connect to find people with shared interests or !groups to join communities around your hobbies.
social_tips: Be genuine and authentic in your interactions
Ask open-ended questions to show interest
Respect others' communication styles and boundaries
neurodivergent_socializing: It's okay to need breaks from social interaction
Quality connections matter more than quantity

zone10_celebration.name: 🎉 Celebration & Recognition Zone
zone10_celebration.description: Celebrate achievements, recognize progress, and spread joy

commands.!joy: Share moments of joy and happiness

help_content.getting_started: Use !celebrate to share your achievements or !wins to track daily victories, no matter how small.
celebration_philosophy: Small wins lead to big victories
Progress is more important than perfection
ways_to_celebrate: Share your story with the community
Create a visual representation of your achievement
Thank those who helped you along the way
Set a new goal to maintain momentum
